notes.title: Replacing Images and Adding Achievements
notes.notes:
●Replacement of images
We replaced the generated AI images with hand-drawn dots.

●Addition of achievements
Achievements were added for each stage.
Please note that there will be some discrepancies between the existing achievements and the total acquisition rate.

notes.title: Image generation AI change
notes.notes: The image used was changed to one generated by the image generation AI "Firefly".

notes.title: Added input reception setting function
notes.notes: Added the ability to set "whether to accept input when the screen is inactive".

notes.title: Changed file structure and added screen size switching function.
notes.notes:
Changed file structure to simplify installation.
A screen size switching function was added because the screen size was small.
